blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.
blocks.zh: 交互式视频世界模型通过文本和相机控制使探索成为可能,而直接对象交互则需要更精细的控制. 手提供了自然界面,但将连续的手动转化为连贯的视觉反应仍然具有挑战性,因为手-物体动态复杂并需要实时计算. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了Lynn Real-Hand,这是一种手控视频世界模型,它统一了与高效流体生成的精确互动模型. 我们控制了100K的相互作用片段,这些片段跨越不同的真实和合成环境,并发展手感监督,以改善精细的手动和物体相互作用。 在此基础上,我们学习了几步生成的因果流图,并引入了区域-意识分数分馏法,结合了互补的视频和图像前作来完善互动动态和视觉外观. 为了进一步减少推论延迟,我们提议使用Ultra-Fast-VAE,这是一个紧凑的视频解码器,它保持了高的重建忠诚度并大大降低计算成本。 与现有方法相比,对Hand Bench进行的广泛评价显示,手跟脚的准确性和视觉质量更高。 我们的全序模型实现了181.67分的FVD和93.02分的MANO Dice分数,而三步因果模型保持了MANO Dice分数92.49分. 对于实时互动,单H200上流的540p会达到18.03个FPS并有741ms的耐久性,最优化的峰值GPU记忆足迹只有34.89GB. 我们将发布数据集,模型权重,以及完整的培训和推断代码,以支持手控视频世界模型的研究.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive video world models are transforming video generation from passive content synthesis into environments that respond to user actions. Early systems such as Genie [ 1 ] demonstrated action-controllable generation, while recent advances in Matrix-Game 3.0 [ 2 ] , PAN [ 3 ] , and open world models [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] have improved interactivity, temporal consistency, and accessibility. Yet most interaction paradigms remain centered on navigation, camera motion, or high-level instructions. These controls determine where users look or move, but offer limited ability to manipulate the objects they encounter. Enabling such manipulation requires a world model to respond not only to changes in viewpoint, but also to the fine-grained actions through which users interact with their surroundings.
blocks.zh: 互动视频世界模型正在将视频生成从被动内容合成转化为响应用户动作的环境. 诸如Genie [1] 等早期系统显示出可操作的生成,而Matrix-Game 3.0 [2], PAN [3] 和开放世界模型[4, 5, 6, 7] 的近期进步则改善了交互性,时间一致性和可访问性. 然而,大多数互动范式仍然以导航、相机运动或高级指令为中心。 这些控制决定了用户的外观或移动位置,但提供了有限的操纵所遇到对象的能力. 促成这种操纵需要一种世界模式,不仅应对观点的变化,而且应对用户与其周围环境互动的精细行动。

blocks.en: Hands offer a direct and expressive interface for this purpose: reaching, grasping, releasing, and coordinated bimanual movements communicate intentions that are difficult to specify through text or navigation commands. Recent efforts, including HandWorld [ 8 ] , Hand2World [ 9 ] , Generated Reality [ 10 ] , Dexterous World Models [ 11 ] , and JointControlVideo [ 12 ] , have begun to connect articulated hand motion with visual generation. However, reliable hand-controlled interaction presents challenges that are distinct from conventional video synthesis. First, hands and their contact regions occupy only a small portion of each frame, so global generative objectives can underemphasize precisely the details that determine control fidelity. Second, accelerating a high-quality video model into a few-step causal generator can amplify local motion errors: the student must preserve articulated interactions while conditioning on its own imperfect history. Finally, even when denoising is accelerated, decoding high-resolution video latents can remain a major obstacle to responsive interaction. These challenges call for a training and inference pipeline that preserves interaction fidelity throughout the transition from full-sequence learning to streaming generation.
blocks.zh: 手为此提供一个直接和表达式的界面:到达,抓住,释放,协调的双人运动传递出难以通过文本或导航命令来说明的意图. 最近的努力,包括HandWorld[8],Hand2World[9],创造现实[10],Dexterous World Models [11],以及联合控制视频 [12] 已经开始将清晰的手动与视觉生成连接起来. 然而,可靠的手控互动带来了不同于传统视频合成的挑战。 首先,双手及其接触区域只占每个框架的一小部分,因此全球基因目标可以低估决定控制忠诚性的细节。 第二,加速一个高质量的视频模型进入一个几步因果生成器,可以扩大局部运动错误:学生必须保持清晰的相互作用,同时根据自己的不完善历史进行条件化. 最后,即使在加速解密时,对高分辨率视频潜伏进行解码仍可成为应对互动的主要障碍。 这些挑战要求有一个培训和推论管道,在整个从全过程学习到流派一代的过渡过程中保持互动的忠诚。

blocks.en: We introduce LynnReal-Hand , an open-source hand-controlled video world model developed to address these challenges end to end. At its core is Interaction-Preserving Training (IPT) , a supervision strategy that explicitly prioritizes fine-grained interaction fidelity at two critical stages: full-sequence pretraining and causal distribution matching. We first build a dataset of 100K interaction clips with aligned hand trajectories, camera poses, and textual descriptions across diverse real and synthetic scenes. During full-sequence learning, we go beyond global flow matching with hand-aware multilevel supervision : a hand-region latent objective penalizes local reconstruction errors directly, while decoded LPIPS and DINOv2 constraints reinforce perceptual structure and hand appearance. This targeted supervision counteracts the weak contribution of small interaction regions to the global training signal and establishes a stronger teacher for subsequent acceleration.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Lynn Real-Hand, 一个开放源码的手控视频世界模型, 其核心是互动-保留培训(IPT),这是一种监督战略,在两个关键阶段,即全序预训和因果分配匹配时,明确优先考虑精细的相互作用忠贞性。 我们首先构建一个由100K交互片段组成的数据集, 并配有一致的手轨,相机的姿势,以及各种真实和合成场景的文字描述。 在全程学习过程中,我们超越了全球流动与手感多层次监督的匹配:手感地区潜在目标直接惩罚当地的重建错误,而解码的LPIPS和DINOv2限制则强化了知觉结构和手表. 这种有针对性的监督抵消了小互动区域对全球培训信号的微弱贡献,并为随后的加速建立更强大的教师。

blocks.en: Building on this pretrained model, we learn a causal flow map [ 13 ] that generates each video chunk in only three denoising transitions. Teacher-forced training with clean history provides an efficient initialization, but leaves a mismatch with inference, where each new chunk depends on previously generated content. We therefore refine the causal student on self-generated rollouts using distribution matching [ 14 , 15 ] . However, global score matching alone does not distinguish the visual evidence needed for interaction dynamics from the evidence needed for scene appearance. To allocate these complementary signals, we formulate region-aware dual-score distillation : a hand-conditioned video teacher and critic guide the entire generated sequence, with higher-noise evaluations emphasizing interaction-related corrections, while a complementary image prior supplies appearance guidance only outside hand regions. This spatial separation is essential because the image prior lacks hand conditions and should not override the specified motion. In this way, IPT addresses complementary failure modes of the two training stages: insufficient hand-local learning during pretraining and degraded interaction fidelity during causal acceleration. For open-ended streaming, a bounded attention window and local temporal-position reset keep the student’s history and positional range finite.
blocks.zh: 基于这个预先训练好的模型,我们学习了一个因果流图[13],它只生成三个去诺的过渡中每个视频块. 具有干净历史的教师强制培训提供了高效的初始化,但留下了与推论不匹配的地方,其中每个新块都依赖于以前生成的内容. 因此,我们利用分布匹配[14,15],完善了因果学生自我产生的推广。 然而,光是全球得分匹配并不能区分互动动态所需的视觉证据和场景外观所需的证据. 为了分配这些互补信号,我们制定了具有区域意识的双分分法:一个手设条件的视频老师和评论家指导整个生成的序列,高噪音评价强调互动相关的校正,而互补的图像先前只提供手设区域以外的外观指导. 这种空间分离是必要的,因为先前的图像缺乏手性条件,不应凌驾于指定的运动之上. 通过这种方式,IPT解决了两个培训阶段的互补故障模式:在预训期间的手工-局部学习不足,在因果加速期间的相互作用忠贞程度下降。 校对:Soup

blocks.en: Efficient generation also requires efficient reconstruction. We therefore introduce Ultra-Fast-VAE , a compact Transformer decoder that preserves the generator’s native latent interface while compressing attention and feed-forward branches and recovering reconstruction quality through representation and temporal distillation. We evaluate the resulting system with HandBench , covering ten hand-interaction sources, including two held-out sources for out-of-distribution testing. On the main benchmark, LynnReal-Hand-Base achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02 ; the evaluated LynnReal-Hand-Fast model, trained with video-score distillation but without the image-guidance branch, retains 92.49 MANO Dice with three denoising steps. In a separate optimized 540p streaming evaluation on one H200, Fast reaches 18.03 FPS .
blocks.zh: 高效发电还需要高效的重建。 因此,我们引入了Ultra-Fast-VAE,这是一个紧凑的变形器解码器,它保留了发电机的原生潜在接口,同时压缩注意力和饲料前进分支,并通过表示和时间蒸馏恢复重建质量。 我们用Hand Bench来评价这个系统, 包括十个人工接触源, 在主要基准上,LynnReal-Hand-Base实现了181.67的FVD和93.02的MANO Dice分数;被评价的LynnReal-Hand-Fast模型经过了视频分数蒸馏训练,但没有图像引导分支,保留了92.49的MANO Dice分数,分三个去诺步骤. 在单H200上单独优化了540p流评价,Fast达到18.03 FPS.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • Interaction-scale data and evaluation. We curate 100K hand-interaction clips with temporally aligned hand, camera, and semantic conditions, and establish HandBench to assess control fidelity and visual quality across diverse scenes and held-out settings. • Interaction-Preserving Training. We develop a unified supervision perspective spanning hand-aware multilevel learning for full-sequence generation and region-aware score allocation for causal distillation, explicitly addressing how hand-control signals are preserved at both stages. • Few-step, open-ended causal generation. We combine causal flow-map learning, refinement on self-generated histories, and bounded-window temporal-position management to support three-step streaming generation without an ever-growing attention cache. • Fast, high-fidelity video decoding. We propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, which compresses a pretrained Transformer decoder while retaining its native latent interface and restoring spatial and temporal reconstruction fidelity through targeted distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 互动尺度数据和评价。 我们用时间对齐的手,相机,和语义条件来管理100K的手动交互剪辑,并设立Hand Bench来评估不同场景和停机设置的控制忠诚度和视觉质量. • 互动保护培训。 我们形成一个统一的监督视角,涵盖全过程生成的手感多层次学习和因果衍射的区域意识分数分配,明确阐述在两个阶段如何保存手感信号。 • 少步、无限制的因果生成。 我们把因果流图学习,自我创造历史的完善,以及边际窗口时间定位管理结合起来,支持三步串流的生成,而无需不断增长的注意力缓存. • 快速、高真实度视频解码。 我们提出Ultra-Fast-VAE,它压缩一个预先训练的变形器解码器,同时保留其原生潜在接口,并通过定向蒸馏恢复空间和时间重建忠心.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Interactive Video World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 互动视频世界模式

blocks.en: Video world models use learned visual prediction to make an environment respond to user inputs. Genie [ 1 ] , Matrix-Game 3.0 [ 2 ] , and PAN [ 3 ] develop action-based interaction and long-horizon simulation. WorldPlay [ 4 ] and RELIC [ 5 ] study geometric consistency and memory, while LingBot-World [ 6 ] and SolarWM [ 7 ] advance open training and deployment. BiWM [ 16 ] provides an open training framework for bidirectional autoregressive world models. These advances provide a foundation for interactive synthesis. Our focus is the additional control and supervision needed when a user specifies articulated hand motion within the generated scene.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型利用所学的视觉预测来让环境响应用户的投入. Genie [1],Matrix-Game 3.0 [2],以及PAN [3] 开发基于动作的交互和长视距模拟. WorldPlay [4]和RELIC [5]研究几何一致性和内存,而LingBot-World [6]和SolarWM [7]则推进公开培训和部署. BiWM [16] 为双向自转世界模型提供了一个开放的培训框架. 这些进展为互动综合提供了基础。 我们的重点是,当用户在生成的场景中明确表明手动时,需要额外的控制和监督。

blocks.en: 2.2 Hand-Controlled Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 手控 视频生成

blocks.en: Hand-conditioned generation represents actions using meshes, joints, or other spatial controls. HandWorld [ 8 ] jointly models video and hand actions; Hand2World [ 9 ] studies hand-driven interaction; and Generated Reality [ 10 ] combines hand and camera conditioning. Dexterous World Models [ 11 ] grounds interaction in rendered static scenes and hand trajectories, while DexAC [ 17 ] , P 3 -WAM [ 18 ] , and JointControlVideo [ 12 ] study complementary structured action representations. DreamDojo [ 19 ] and EgoWM [ 20 ] further connect action-conditioned prediction with embodied learning. We build on this problem setting and study its full training-to-delivery path. In particular, our method emphasizes local hand supervision, separates temporal and appearance score gradients during causal distillation, and reduces the codec cost. Section 5 compares the available native model paths under their recorded conditions.

Dexterous World Models [11] 将互动建立在已变的静态场景和手轨中,而DexAC [17],P 3 - WAM [18],以及联合控制 视频[12]研究互补结构化行动表述. DreamDojo [19]和EgoWM [20] 进一步将行动条件的预测与体现的学习联系起来. 我们利用这一问题的设定,研究其全面的培训与交付途径。 特别是,我们的方法强调局部的手监督,在因果蒸馏时将时间和外观分数梯度分开,并降低编码成本. 第5节比较了记录条件下可用的本土模式路径。

blocks.en: 2.3 Efficient Generation and Open Recipes
blocks.zh: 2.3 高效生成和开放食谱

blocks.en: Few-step generation reduces the repeated computation of diffusion sampling. AnyFlow [ 13 ] learns finite flow transitions; DMD [ 14 ] estimates distribution-matching updates from real and fake scores; and Self-Forcing [ 15 ] trains autoregressive generators on their own histories. PackForcing [ 21 ] bounds long-video history through partitioned KV caches, compression, and context selection. DuoMatching [ 22 ] combines video-joint and image-marginal supervision. For hand control, these objectives must preserve a small, moving interaction region as well as global visual appearance. Our score separation assigns these responsibilities explicitly. We also address the complementary rendering cost: Ultra-Fast-VAE retains the native generator latent interface and reconstructs each completed chunk with narrower attention and feed-forward branches, connecting denoising acceleration to a measured reconstruction–latency trade-off.
blocks.zh: 少步生成减少重复计算扩散采样. AnyFlow [13] 学习有限的流量转换; DMD [14] 从真实的和假的得分中估计分布的匹配更新;以及自强 [15] 列车自转式发电机在自己的历史中. PackForcing [21] 通过分割的 KV 缓存,压缩,以及上下文选择来限定长视频历史. DuoMatching [22] 结合视频-联合和图像-边际监督. 为了控制手势,这些目标必须保持一个小的、动人的相互作用区域以及全球视觉。 我们的分数分离明确指定了这些责任。 我们还解决了互补的渲染成本问题:Ultra-Fast-VAE保留了本土发电机潜在接口,并用更窄的注意力和支线重建每个完成的块,将点名加速与量度的重建-长期性权衡联系起来。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: LynnReal-Hand aims to synthesize continuous visual interactions conditioned on sequential hand motions. We first formulate this task as conditional video generation and introduce hand-aware supervision to improve the fidelity of fine-grained interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and further refine the model on self-generated trajectories through complementary video and image score distillation. Finally, we introduce Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact decoder that efficiently reconstructs video frames from generated latents to enable real-time interaction.
blocks.zh: Lynn Real-Hand旨在合成以连续手动为条件的连续视觉相互作用. 我们首先将这项任务制定为有条件的视频生成,并引入手感监督,以提高精细的交流的忠实性. 在这个基础上,我们学习了几步生成的因果流图,并通过互补的视频和图像分数蒸馏,进一步完善了自产生轨迹上的模型. 最后,我们引入了Ultra-Fast-VAE,这是一个紧凑的解码器,可以高效地从生成的潜伏物重建视频帧,实现实时交互.

blocks.en: Although the preceding stages substantially reduce the number of denoising steps, decoding the generated latents into video frames remains a significant bottleneck for real-time interaction. High-fidelity Transformer-based VAE decoders incur substantial computational overhead, even with recent streaming optimizations [ 32 , 33 ] . Lightweight CNN alternatives offer lower latency but often sacrifice fine-grained reconstruction quality [ 34 ] , particularly for articulated hands and manipulated objects. To address this trade-off, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact Transformer decoder that combines representation-preserving architectural compression with targeted reconstruction distillation.
blocks.zh: 虽然前几个阶段大大减少了去名步骤的数量,但将生成的潜伏物解码成视频帧仍然是实时互动的一个重要瓶颈。 高纯度变形器基于VAE解码器发生大量的计算间接费用,即使最近流线优化[32,33]. 轻量级CNN替代品的耐久性较低,但往往牺牲精细的重建质量[34],特别是对于手和被操纵的物品而言。 为了解决这种权衡,我们提议Ultra-Fast-VAE,一个紧凑的变形器解码器,将代表式保存建筑压缩和有针对性的重建蒸馏相结合.

blocks.en: 3.6 Data Engine Construction
blocks.zh: 3.6 国家 数据引擎建设

blocks.en: We construct a unified data pipeline for hand- and camera-conditioned egocentric video generation. The pipeline converts heterogeneous videos into interaction clips with temporally aligned 3D hand parameters, hand renderings, camera trajectories, and textual descriptions. It combines visual quality filtering, motion annotation, interaction verification, and diversity-aware sampling to obtain a training corpus of 100K clips.
blocks.zh: 我们建造一个统一的数据管道 用于手动和相机设备 以自我为中心的视频生成 管道将各种视频转换成具有时间上一致的三维手参数、手渲染、照相机轨迹和文字描述的交互剪辑。 它将视觉质量过滤、运动注释、互动核查和多样性意识取样结合起来,以获得100K剪辑的培训材料。

blocks.en: We collect videos from public egocentric datasets and online sources, supplemented with first-person interaction videos synthesized by MiniMax-H3 [ 26 ] . Source videos must have a resolution of at least 720p, a frame rate of at least 24 fps, and more than 200 frames; only egocentric views are retained from multiview recordings. We use OmniShotCut [ 37 ] to identify shot boundaries and exclude transition intervals. Within each continuous shot, we extract 125- or 240-frame clips at 24 fps. To provide a sharp conditioning image, we select the starting frame with the highest grayscale Laplacian variance among up to ten valid frames following each candidate cut position. Clips are encoded as H.264 videos with a 768-pixel short side while preserving aspect ratio. We additionally enhance a subset of videos using SparkVSR to improve visual quality. We reject poorly exposed clips using brightness statistics, then retain the top 80% ranked by the overall COVER quality score [ 38 ] . PaddleOCR detects persistent subtitles in the lower third of the image. Subtitled landscape clips are discarded; portrait clips are consistently cropped only when subtitle removal requires trimming at most 25% of the image height. All cropping precedes motion annotation.
blocks.zh: 由MiniMax-H3[26]合成的第一人称互动视频补充。 源视频必须具有至少720p的分辨率,帧率至少24fps,以及超过200帧;从多视图录制中只保留以自我为中心的观点. 我们用OmniShotCut [37] 来识别射击边界,排除过渡间隔. 在每一次连续镜头中, 我们提取125或240帧的片段 在24英尺高度。 为了提供尖锐的配置图像,我们在每个候选人切换位置之后,在最多10个有效框架中选择灰度最高的Laplacian差异的起始框架。 剪贴被编码为H.264视频,短边为768像素,同时保留宽比. 我们用SparkVSR 来提升视觉质量。 我们拒绝使用亮度统计数据曝光率低的片段, PaddleOCR在图像的下三分之一检测到持续字幕. 字幕的风景片片段被丢弃;肖像片片片段只有在字幕删除需要最多修剪25%的图像高度时才会持续裁剪. 所有裁剪都先于运动注释.

blocks.en: We apply the WiLoR hand detector [ 39 ] frame by frame, remove duplicate and temporally inconsistent detections, and discard clips with hands detected in fewer than 50% of frames. For retained clips, short gaps bounded by valid same-side detections are filled by interpolating box centers and sizes when the preceding hand is away from the image boundary. Remaining gaps are addressed with SAM 3 [ 40 ] , prompted with “hand” within an enlarged region around the preceding same-side box. We convert the largest predicted instance into a box, preserve the track’s handedness, and limit consecutive SAM-based completions. After further cleanup and smoothing, clips with hand coverage below 90% are rejected. WiLoR then estimates MANO [ 41 ] pose, shape, global orientation, and camera-space translation from the completed boxes. We temporally smooth parameters within valid intervals and render the resulting meshes on a black background, matching the video clip’s frame count, resolution, and frame rate.
blocks.zh: 我们按帧使用WiLOR手式检测器[39]帧,去除重复的和时间上不一致的检测,并用在不到50%的帧中检测到的手丢弃剪辑. 对于保留片段,在前手远离图像边界时,以有效的同侧检测为界的短缺口通过插箱中心和大小填充. 其余的差距用SAM 3[40]来解决,在扩大的区域中,用“手”推动,围绕前面的同一边框。 我们把最大的预测实例转换成一个盒子, 保存赛道的功率, 经过进一步的清理和平滑,手覆盖率低于90%的片段被否决. WiLOR随后估算了MANO [41] 的姿势,形状,全局方向,以及从完成的框中翻译的相机空间. 我们在有效间隔内时间上平滑的参数, 并让产生的网格在黑色背景上,

blocks.en: We estimate camera intrinsics and per-frame poses with ViPE [ 42 ] , using GeoCalib for intrinsic initialization and MoGe-2 metric depth priors to constrain scale during geometric optimization. To reduce interference from moving hands, we extract binary silhouettes from the hand renderings, apply morphological closing and dilation, and exclude these regions from the geometric constraints. Reusing hand annotations replaces ViPE’s generic foreground detection and segmentation stages. We reject trajectories with missing or invalid poses, inconsistent frame indexing, translation jumps, abrupt rotations, or repeated large direction reversals. Translation steps exceeding five times the local mean, adjacent rotations above 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} , and relative rotations above 100 ∘ 100^{\circ} within approximately 1.2 seconds trigger rejection.
blocks.zh: 我们用维PE [42] 估计摄像头的内在和每帧的外观,使用GeoCalib进行内在初始化和MoGe-2 度量深度,在几何优化时限制尺度。 为了减少移动手的干扰,我们从手的渲染中提取二进制硅,应用形态闭合和拓扑,并将这些地区排除在几何限制之外. 重用手说明取代了VIPE的通用前缘探测和分割阶段. 我们拒绝带有缺失或无效的姿势的轨迹,拒绝不一致的帧索引,拒绝翻译跳跃,拒绝突然旋转,拒绝重复大方向逆转. 翻译步骤超过本地平均值的5倍,相邻旋转超过60~60~circ},相对旋转超过100~100~circ}在大约1.2秒内触发拒绝.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3.8-Flash-Next [ 43 ] , deployed with vLLM, to assign background and activity labels and generate interaction descriptions from chronologically ordered frames sampled at 1 Hz, including the first frame. Descriptions establish the initial scene and summarize visible actions and state changes without inventing unobserved events. Camera motion and viewpoint changes are excluded from the text, leaving them to the camera condition. In a separate verification pass, the model examines frames sampled every 25 frames and checks three criteria: an egocentric viewpoint, only the camera wearer’s hands with no other people visible, and purposeful hand–object interaction. We retain only clips that explicitly pass all three checks. Valid interactions include grasping, placing, assembly, tool use, and sustained manipulation; hovering, empty gestures, and static display are excluded.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Qwen3.8-Flash-Next [43],与vLLM一起部署,来指定背景和活动标签,并生成按时间顺序在1Hz取样的帧的交互描述,包括第一个帧. 描述建立初始场景,总结可见的动作和状态变化而不发明不可观察的事件. 相机运动和视线变化被排除在文字之外,留给相机条件. 在一份单独的核查通行证中,模型检查了每25帧的帧样本,并检查了三项标准:以自我为中心的观点,只有照相机穿戴者的双手没有其他人可以看见,以及有目的的手-物体交互。 我们只保留了明确通过所有三项检查的片段。 有效的相互作用包括抓住,放置,组装,工具使用,以及持续的操纵;徘徊,空姿势,静态显示被排除在外.

blocks.en: Finally, we sample without replacement using weights proportional to the product of inverse background-label and activity-label frequencies. This increases the selection probability of less frequent environments and actions. Each selected sample contains a video clip, aligned hand parameters and renderings, camera intrinsics and poses, and an interaction caption, providing visual targets and complementary motion and language conditions for generation training.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们用与反向背景标签和活性标签频率成正比的权重进行取样,而不进行替换。 这增加了选择环境和行动较少的可能性。 每个选定的样本都包含一个视频剪辑、对齐的手势参数和渲染、相机内在和姿势以及互动标题,为生成培训提供视觉目标以及辅助运动和语言条件。

blocks.en: 4 HandBench: Evaluating Hand-Controlled Interaction
blocks.zh: 4 Hand Bench: 评估手控 互动

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准建设

blocks.en: Evaluating hand-controlled video generation requires assessing not only visual realism but also whether the generated interactions faithfully follow the specified hand motions. Existing video quality metrics alone cannot adequately capture such fine-grained control accuracy, particularly for complex hand-object interactions. To enable a more comprehensive evaluation, we construct HandBench, a benchmark that jointly assesses hand-motion fidelity, visual quality, and scene consistency across diverse interaction scenarios.
blocks.zh: 评价手控视频生成不仅需要评估视觉现实主义,而且需要评估生成的相互作用是否忠实地遵循指定的手动. 仅凭现有的视频质量衡量标准无法充分掌握这种精细的控制精度,特别是对于复杂的手物体相互作用而言。 为了能够进行更全面的评价,我们构建了Hand Bench这一基准,该基准将联合评估手动忠诚度、视觉质量以及各种互动情景的一致性。

blocks.en: HandBench comprises 200 video sequences collected from ten sources, with 20 sequences each from EgoDex [ 44 ] , H2O [ 45 ] , HOI-4D [ 46 ] , OpenAoE [ 47 ] , TACO [ 48 ] , ARCTIC [ 49 ] , CaptainCook4D [ 50 ] , Ego4D [ 51 ] , EPIC-KITCHENS-100 [ 52 ] , and synthetic scenes generated by H3 [ 26 ] . These sequences encompass diverse interaction patterns, including fine-grained object manipulation, coordinated bimanual actions, tool use, and interactions with articulated or deformable objects. For each sequence, we preserve the original video interval, spatial crop, and temporally aligned hand and camera conditions to ensure consistent reference-based evaluation. We use 160 sequences from eight sources for the main benchmark. H2O and TACO are excluded from world-model training and reserved for out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation, with 20 sequences from each source.
blocks.zh: Hand Bench由从10个来源收集的200个视频序列组成,各有20个序列来自EgoDex [44],H2O [45],HOI-4D [46],OpenAoE [47],TACO [48],ARCTIC [49],Cook4D [50],Ego4D [51],EPIC-KITCHENS-100 [52],以及H3 [26]产生的合成场景. 这些序列包含多种相互作用模式,包括精细的物体操纵,协调的双人动作,工具使用,以及与清晰或可变形物体的相互作用. 对于每个序列,我们保留原始的视频间隔,空间作物,以及时序一致的手和相机条件,以确保一致的基于参考的评价. 我们使用来自8个来源的160个序列作为主要基准. H2O和TACO被排除在世界模式训练之外,并保留用于分配外(OO)评价,每个来源有20个序列.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Metrics and Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价计量和规程

blocks.en: A reliable evaluation of hand-controlled generation must distinguish accurate motion following from visual plausibility, as realistic-looking videos may still deviate substantially from the prescribed hand trajectories. We therefore adopt projected MANO [ 41 ] mesh-silhouette Dice as our primary control metric, measuring the spatial agreement between reference hand geometry and hands independently reconstructed from generated frames. This metric evaluates whether the generated hand configurations follow the intended movements while accounting for their projected positions and shapes.
blocks.zh: 对手控生成的可靠评价必须区分精确的运动和视觉的可信度,因为现实的视频仍然可能大大偏离规定的手轨。 因此,我们采用预测的MANO [41] mesh-silhouette Dice作为我们的主要控制指标,测量参考手几何和手从生成的框中独立重建的空间协议。 这一衡量标准评价生成的手配置是否遵循预期的移动,同时考虑其预测位置和形状.

blocks.en: To complement control accuracy, we evaluate reconstruction fidelity using PSNR, SSIM [ 53 ] , and LPIPS [ 24 ] , and assess video distribution quality using FVD [ 54 ] . We further measure semantic alignment and temporal consistency through weighted CLIP [ 55 ] similarity and VBench [ 56 ] subject and background consistency metrics. Camera-motion adherence is evaluated using background motion agreement, allowing us to distinguish viewpoint following from hand articulation. Together, these metrics provide complementary assessments of interaction fidelity and visual coherence without reducing them to a single aggregate score. For fair comparison, we preserve each method’s native temporal sampling and align generated frames with their corresponding reference frames. All methods are evaluated on common valid support, with scalar metrics aggregated using equal weights across data sources and FVD computed from pooled video features. Detailed metric definitions and evaluation procedures are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 为了补充控制准确性,我们使用PSNR、SSIM[53]和LPIPS[24]来评价重建忠诚度,并使用FVD[54]来评价视频分发质量。 我们通过加权的CLIP[55]相似性和V Bench[56]主题和背景一致性衡量标准,进一步衡量语义一致性和时间一致性。 使用背景运动协议来评价相机运动的坚持性,使我们能够区分随手表达的观点。 这些衡量标准共同提供互动忠诚性和视觉一致性的补充评估,而不将其降低为单一的总分。 为了进行公平比较,我们保留了每种方法的原生时间采样,并将生成的框架与相应的参考框架保持一致。 所有方法都通过共同的有效支持加以评价,采用不同数据来源的同等权重来汇总scalar 度量衡,并从集合视频功能计算出FVD。 附录A提供了详细的计量定义和评价程序。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: While LynnReal-Hand demonstrates promising performance in hand-controlled video generation, several directions remain open for further exploration. First, our current causal model operates with a limited temporal context and does not explicitly model long-term memory, which may constrain interaction consistency over extended horizons. Incorporating persistent memory mechanisms could enable more coherent and continuous interactions in long-running virtual environments. Second, we observe that the causal flow-map model learned in Stage II already exhibits promising generation quality within the training sequence lengths, even before subsequent score distillation. This suggests an interesting direction toward directly learning high-quality few-step generators through flow-map objectives, potentially eliminating the need for computationally expensive DMD training. We leave the exploration of these directions to future work.
blocks.zh: 虽然Lynn Real-Hand在手控视频制作中表现出有希望的性能,但仍有多个方向可供进一步探索. 首先,我们目前的因果模型在有限的时间背景下运作,没有明确地模拟长期记忆,这可能会限制互动一致性超过延伸视野. 纳入持久的内存机制可以在长期虚拟环境中进行更加连贯和持续的互动。 第二,我们发现,第二阶段所学的因果流动图模型已经在培训序列长度内,甚至在随后的分数蒸馏之前,就已经显示出有希望的生成质量。 这表明通过流程图目标直接学习高品质的几步发电机是一个有趣的方向,有可能消除对计算成本昂贵的DMD培训的需求。 我们把这些方向的探索留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce LynnReal-Hand for continuous visual interaction through natural hand motion. Hand-aware supervision, few-step causal generation, and Ultra-Fast-VAE combine accurate control, high visual fidelity, and efficient decoding. Experiments across diverse interaction scenarios support the effectiveness of this framework.

blocks.en: The image bridge maps five 24-channel H3 planes through a width-256 projection, eight spatial residual blocks, and 2 × 2\times pixel-shuffle upsampling. Physical-offset embeddings select the corresponding frame. The bridge is frozen after fitting, while its input derivative remains active. Four temporal locations supply image supervision. After the bridge VJP, image gradients are zeroed inside the hand ROI.

blocks.en: The dual-score configuration uses video CFG3, shift-3 student rollout, and shift-12 video-score noise. The negative branch retains image and camera conditions while omitting hand and text conditions. Critics receive five optimizer updates per generator update after 10 warmup updates; the image weight ramps from 0.001 to 0.1 during warmup. Student EMA is 0.999. Earlier generated histories are detached when replaying trainable rollout exits.
blocks.zh: 双打分数配置采用视频CFG3,换班-3学生推出,换班-12视频分数噪音. 负分支保留图像和相机条件,同时省略手和文字条件. 批评者在10次热身更新后每台发电机获得5次优化更新;在热身期间,图像重量坡道从0.001到0.1. 学生EMA为0.999. 早期生成的历史在重新播放可训练的推出出口时被剥离.

blocks.en: The evaluated Fast model uses video-score training with uniform noise, paired hand supervision, and a non-hand adversarial term; its image-score branch and image critic are disabled.

blocks.en: C.1 Evaluated Model Paths
blocks.zh: C.1 评价的示范路径

blocks.en: LynnReal-Hand-Base uses joint CFG3 and the native H3 VAE at 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 . Its 30-point shift-3 schedule performs 29 Euler updates with two evaluations per update. Fast uses three shift-3 flow-map transitions, W2 history, native H3 anchor encoding, Tiny-H3 [ 34 ] hand encoding, and FP16 Ultra-Fast-VAE for quality evaluation. The same Fast model supplies the pairwise preference results.
blocks.zh: Lynn Real-Hand-Base在1344×768 1344\时使用联合CFG3和本土H3 VAE. 其30点的班次-3时间表进行了29次欧拉更新,每次更新两次评价。 Fast使用三班-3流图转换,W2历史,本土H3锚编码,Tiny-H3[34]手编码,FP16 Ultra-Fast-VAE用于质量评价. 同样的"快车"模型提供双向偏好结果.

blocks.en: Streaming Hand2World [ 9 ] and JointControlVideo [ 12 ] use released models. Bidirectional Hand2World adapts rank-256 attention LoRA and its camera adapter on the adaptation corpus (84,305 examples; 32,000 sample visits), retaining 50 native sampling steps, CFG1, and the full Wan VAE without TeaCache [ 62 ] . Generated Reality [ 10 ] adapts rank-32 LoRA and a motion encoder in the official 5B model on 1,146 ARCTIC clips from subjects s01–s09, reserving s10 for reproduction validation. All methods retain native source-frame alignment without frame repetition or playback changes.
blocks.zh: 流转的手掌世界[9]和联合控制 视频[12]使用发布模型. 双向Hand2World调整了256级注意LORA及其相机适配器的适应器(84,305例;32,000次抽样访问),保留了50个本土采样步骤CFG1,以及完整的Wan VAE无茶卡切[62]. 生成现实[10]将排名-32 LORA和一个运动编码器在官方5B型号上的1,146 ACTIC剪辑中从主题s01–s09上修改,保留s10进行复制验证. 所有方法都保留原生源框对齐,不重复帧或回放更改.

blocks.en: For both LynnReal-Hand-Base and LynnReal-Hand-Fast, per-block AdaLN modulation depends only on the prescribed time conditions. A fixed sampling schedule therefore needs only the modulation values at its visited times and clean-conditioning boundaries; Fast uses the corresponding start/end-time pairs. The inference export stores these values directly and omits the learned block projection matrices, avoiding their loading and device residency. The default Base and three-step Fast tables occupy 535.3 and 55.4 MiB, respectively. This storage specialization leaves the sampling rule unchanged; total memory also includes activations, codecs, KV caches, and graph buffers.
blocks.zh: 林恩·瑞尔·汉德·巴斯和林恩·瑞尔·汉德·法斯特 AdaLN 调制只取决于规定的时间条件. 因此,固定的采样时间表只需其访问时间的调值和清洁空调边界; Fast使用相应的始末对. 推导输出直接存储这些值,省略了学到的块投影矩阵,避免了它们的装载和装置耐用性. 默认的Base和三步快表分别占据535.3和55.4 MiB. 这种存储专业化使采样规则保持不变;总内存还包括激活,解码器,KV缓存,以及图缓冲器.

blocks.en: The accelerated Fast path combines quantized projections, fused operators, condition caches, full 50-block DiT compilation, CUDA graphs, and W8A8 Ultra-Fast-VAE on one H200. Native 960 × 544 960\times 544 computation is vertically cropped to 960 × 540 960\times 540 output. Three transitions and W2 history are retained.

blocks.en: One warmup rollout and three measured repeats on the 124-frame example give 15 steady full chunks, yielding 18.0295 FPS and mean latency 740.69 ms. Latency starts with available hand/camera conditions and ends when synchronized frames reach host memory; it includes online hand encoding, prefill, generation, and decoding. Continuous FPS additionally includes the preceding clean KV commit. Loading, initial-image conditioning, cold compilation, warmup, video encoding, acquisition, and display are excluded. The Fast peak in Table 2 comes from a separate measurement of the released sampling-specialized model on the same 124-frame input geometry. After one full warmup and release of unused allocator cache, three rollouts reach 34.89 GiB maximum PyTorch-allocated device memory. Conditions are prepared in advance, with the native H3 VAE and Qwen encoder off device during generation. The peak includes the quantized transformer, online hand encoder, Ultra-Fast-VAE, KV caches, and graph buffers; cold loading and conditioning preparation are excluded. Timing and the 768p quality evaluation use separate model weights and protocols.
blocks.zh: 在124个框架的例子上,一个热量推开和三个经测量的重复提供了15个稳定的整块,产生18.0295个FPS和平均耐久性740.69毫秒。 latency从可用的手/相机条件开始,当同步帧到达主机内存时结束;它包括在线手编码,预填,生成,以及解码. 持续的FPS还包括之前的清洁KV承诺. 装入,初始图像调制,冷编译,热身,视频编码,获取,显示不包括在内. 表2中的快峰来自在同一124帧输入几何上对释放的采样专业模型进行单独测量. 在一次完全热身并释放未使用的分配器缓存后,三次展开达到34.89 GiB最大PyTorch-分配设备内存. 预先准备条件,在生成时使用原生的H3 VAE和Quen编码器关闭设备. 峰值包括整数变压器,在线手式编码器,Ultra-Fast-VAE,KV缓存,以及图缓冲器;冷装和调制准备被排除在外. 计时和768p质量评价使用单独的模型权重和协议.

blocks.en: Figure 8 summarizes width compression, projection initialization, and reconstruction distillation.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Ultra-Fast-VAE compression and training. Importance selection narrows attention and FFN branches while preserving the residual backbone; ridge refitting initializes their output projections. blocks.en: The decoder retains 26 blocks and a 2048-channel residual stream, with eight 64-dimensional attention heads and 1536-channel SwiGLU branches. It has 361.217M parameters. As in the H3-compatible LightVAE [ 35 ] , 28 overlapping 16 × 16 16\times 16 latent tiles are blended spatially. Each tile processes the five current latents using the seven-position reference RoPE clock; the readout crops 20 native positions to 17 video frames. Attention is joint within a chunk and causal between chunks, with no future latents or decoder history cache.
blocks.zh: 解码器保留了26个块和一个2048通道的残流,有8个64维的注意力头和1536通道的SwiGLU分支. 它有361.217M参数. 与H3兼容的LightVAE [35]中一样,28个重叠的16×16 16\时16个潜在瓦片在空间上混合. 每个瓦片使用七位参考ROPE时钟处理5个当前潜伏物;读取作物20个原生位置到17个视频帧. 注意在块内部和块之间的因果之间是连在一起的,没有未来的潜伏或解码历史缓存.

blocks.en: Energy-ranked heads/channels and ridge-fitted output projections initialize the reduced branches, as defined in Section 3.5 . Reconstruction fine-tuning updates the student decoder while frozen full-width branches provide detached local and feature targets. Neither the teacher branches nor the image bridge appears in the deployed decoder.

blocks.en: Training uses native-H3 latents and original frames from 100,722 videos across 12 sources. A disjoint 1,394-video pool is excluded from fitting and calibration; 200 stratified videos from it select the export. Each update accumulates two videos, each with two consecutive 17-frame chunks. Dense MSE supervises all pixels; sampled spatial and perceptual losses emphasize hand appearance. Temporal and boundary losses match changes in reconstruction error across adjacent frames, including chunk transitions. Table 7 lists coefficients. LPIPS [ 24 ] and DINOv2 [ 25 ] provide frozen perceptual features; the loss families build on LynnReal-Omni [ 35 ] .

Export averages six late-training parameter states. FlashAttention-3 [ 60 ] , fused RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU/residual operations, static compilation, and CUDA graphs reduce execution cost. Frame packing and synchronized host transfer are included in measured decoding latency.

blocks.en: All decoders reconstruct the same native-H3 caches from 200 source-stratified validation videos, comprising 29,818 frames across 12 sources and distinct from HandBench.
